title: A charges document is due with the oldest items
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:15 AM

System Requirements

System Requirements

Up to a specific base amount, a minimum charge is to be levied. A
percentage charge is to be calculated for the portion of the dunning
amount that exceeds this base amount.

Charges are to be restricted to a maximum when interest is posted.

A charges document is due with the oldest items

System Requirements

Interest is not to be calculated on penalty charges and charges

Penalty charges and charges are to be dunned with the main
receivables causing the charges and with the same dunning level

Penalty charges and charges should not contribute to the dunning
balance

Procedure

Enhancements * Define Customer-Specific Function Modules

Procedure

In the Implementation Guide for Contract Accounts Receivable
and Payable , under |}}Business Transactions > Dunning Notices
,in the

column Offset Charge in the charges schedule, define an offset

Configure Charges Schedule for Dunning Procedure

that you calculate according to the following formula:

Offset = Minimum charge — (base amount * percentage/100)

The base amount is 50 EUR, minimum charge 5 EUR (= 1%)
Offset = 5 — 50* 1/100 = 4.5

Do not make an entry in the Maximum Charge field in the charges

schedule since this charges restriction refers to the interest
calculation (see |*Business Transactions » Dunning Notices

Configure Charges Schedule for Dunning Procedure 49 ).Instead,
set the indicator Interest before Charges in the dunning level (see

Business Transactions } Dunning Notices } Configure Dunning
Procedure | ) and define the function module

FKK_SPECIALCHARGE_0360 (or another customer-defined
function module with other limit amounts) for event 0360.

In the standard, the due date of the charges document is the

current system date.You can change the due date of the charges
document in a customer-defined function module for event 0360

that first calls the function module FKK_SAMPLE_0360 or (for
charges restriction) FKK_SPECIALCHARGE_0360.The example
coding in function module ZFKK_SAMPLE_0360 calls the module
FKK_SPECIALCHARGE_0360 and transfers the due date of the

oldest main receivable to the charges document as due date.Define
the function module in the Implementation Guide for Contract

Accounts Receivable and Payable under
Enhancements » Define Customer-Specific Function Modules

Program

Procedure

Define a rule for additinal receivables where the indicator Subject
to Interest is not set.To do this, in the Implementation Guide for

Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable choose
Transactions » Additional Receivables Define Rules for

Business

Additional Receivables

In the dunning procedure set the indicator Dun New Documents
Immediately for the dunning level.

Do not set the indicator Consider for Calculation of Dunning
Balance in the rule for additional receivables.
